hookups.source: https://myescambia.com/our-services/parks-and-recreation/equestrian-center ('75 electric camping sites ... 35 are full hook-up, including 30/50 amp, water and sewer'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 75 electric sites, 35 of them full hook-up; part of the event facility, within walking distance of the arenas and barns. 'Ample vehicle and large rig parking.'

sites.source: https://myescambia.com/our-services/parks-and-recreation/equestrian-center ('The Escambia County Equestrian Center has 75 electric camping sites that are part of our event facility'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://myescambia.com/our-services/parks-and-recreation/equestrian-center ('A sanitary dump station is available on-site, free to person renting camp sites'; facility features 'Restrooms and showers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve by calling 850-941-6042; pay the invoice by cash or check. Up to 14 nights, subject to availability; contracted events have priority, and the county may reassign sites or vacate camping lots for special events with 24 hours' notice. Layover/overnight requests (stalls and electric sites) need at least 24 hours' notice, Mon-Fri before 3 pm.

booking.source: https://myescambia.com/our-services/parks-and-recreation/equestrian-center ('Campers must make a reservation by calling 850-941-6042. Cash or check must be used to pay your invoice. Reservations are accepted for up to 14 nights, subject to availability. Upcoming contracted events have priority'; stabling: 'at least 24 hours in advance, Monday through Friday, BEFORE 3 p.m.'), read 2026-10-21

note: County-run equine event park at 7750 Mobile Hwy, Pensacola; the campground is part of the event facility. Horses are not permitted in the campground. Not equestrian-only - open to general RVers. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 75 electric sites (35 full hookup, 30/50-amp, water+sewer), dump, reservable by phone; added showers, fcfs never, 14-night max and the event-priority/cash-only terms. Note trimmed of hookup/site/booking/rating text. Not stated: rates (none posted), season, site lengths.
flags: Criteria (event/horse camp?): the county page describes the 75 sites as 'part of our event facility', gives event campers priority, may vacate lots for special events on 24 hours' notice, and markets the place as a 'horse motel' layover; it never says the campground is open to RVers without a horse or an event, nor does it say it isn't (horses are not permitted in the campground itself). No camping rates are posted. A phone call to 850-941-6042 would settle whether a passing RVer can book a night.
